QuestInfo.name: A Blacksmith in My Own Right!
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p504#, the master blacksmith of #m10004000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my skills.
QuestInfo.1: #p504#, the master blacksmith of #m10004000#, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat #r#o20#s and #o21#s#k, then create an #b#t4010105##k and a #b#t4010106##k and bring them back to him.
QuestInfo.2: #p504#, the master craftsman of #m10004000#, was amazed by my work and handed me a #t4130002#. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter the stats of equipment. Maybe I should give it a try.

0.0: Word has it that you've become a fine blacksmith. I want to see for myself if the rumors are true. Judging by your tools and your stance, it seems you've built up quite a bit of skill and experience. Care to show me what you can do?

yes.0: Confident, aren't you? Good! Then go defeat #r#o20#s#k and #r#o21#s#k, and bring #b1 #t4010105##k and #b1 #t4010106##k. You can find #o20# around #m10004000#, and #o21# appears to be found in the Ant Tunnel in #m10005000#. Shouldn't be too difficult. I'll be waiting!

no.0: Looks like you haven't quite reached the needed level of skill, have you?

1.0: Let's see... These are exceptionally well made. I'm genuinely impressed that you've reached this level of craftsmanship. Yes, this is the quality one would expect from a true blacksmith. Your dedication to honing your skills is admirable. I suppose this calls for a special reward.

yes.0: This #t4130002# is a unique item that can be used during crafting to alter the abilities of equipment. Because it's so delicate, you may sometimes get disappointing results, but, if handled properly, it might produce something far beyond your expectations.
yes.1: If you want to test the limits of your blacksmithing skills, I highly recommend giving it a try. Keep striving forward!

mob.0: It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Show me what you can do!

item.0: It looks like you haven't collected all the materials I asked for. Show me what you can do!
